extracted.intended_audience: prospective doctoral applicants in applied sciences, engineering, and mathematics (and their recommenders)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and expectations for applicants to the Hertz Fellowship, a national doctoral fellowship in applied sciences, engineering, and mathematics. Covers eligibility, selection focus, recommender role, and the fellowship's benefits and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: target applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hertz Fellowship provides financial and lifelong professional support for the nation’s most promising doctoral students in the applied sciences, engineering and mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be doctoral students (or prospective doctoral students) in applied sciences, engineering, or mathematics and positioned to be among the nation's most promising talent. The fellowship is awarded through a rigorous selection process and provides up to five years of funding (valued at up to $250,000).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection focus: tackling challenging and interdisciplinary problems
rubrics_metrics.description: "We’re interested in individuals tackling challenging questions in their fields, but also determined to solve big interdisciplinary problems facing the nation and the world."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates who pursue hard problems within their discipline and demonstrate determination to address large interdisciplinary challenges with national or global significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation letters: role of recommenders
rubrics_metrics.description: Our recommenders in academia and industry are integral in helping students apply for the Hertz Fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should secure recommenders (from academia and/or industry) who can attest to the applicant's potential and fit for the fellowship; recommenders are a required and important part of the application process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom to Innovate (research independence & flexibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: As a Hertz Fellow, you gain the Freedom to Innovate® and the backing of a community dedicated to your success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship supports flexibility for Fellows to secure their top choice in advisor and research group, explore ideas beyond the constraints of an advisor’s grants, develop collaborative projects, and reduce distractions — implying the program values applicants who will make use of research independence and pursue ambitious, self-directed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentorship and professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows also work with a dedicated mentor throughout their fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program provides career support, mentorship, networking, and partner-facilitated internships and professional development; applicants should be prepared to engage in mentorship and make use of professional-development opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community attributes: curiosity, creativity, mutual respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Hertz Fellows find common ground in curiosity, creativity, and mutual respect — leading to collaborations that cross disciplines and change the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation values collaborative, curious, creative individuals who contribute positively to a cross-disciplinary community; community fit and collaborative potential are implicit desiderata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact orientation: potential to change trajectories and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: From the moment the Hertz Fellowship is awarded, it changes the trajectory of a life — and often, the course of science itself. Freed from financial constraints and emboldened to take risks, Hertz Fellows pursue ideas that shape entire industries and define new fields of study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate potential for high-impact work — research that can shift careers, influence science, and lead to real-world solutions; the Foundation highlights past Fellows' impact as exemplars.
